items.title: Decrypt's Perpetual Futures Integration
points: Decrypt launches perpetual futures trading (leveraged bets on price movements using borrowed funds, with no expiration date) directly in its news platform via Solana's Phoenix exchange, becoming the first news publisher to offer this.
The integration runs through the Decrypt Money Account, allowing single-balance funding for prediction markets, swaps, Earn products, and perps.
The Money Account recently added confidential transfers through Helius, providing privacy protections for transaction data on Solana.
This is part of 'The Information Exchange,' Decrypt's vision combining news, market data, and trading markets in one destination.

items.title: Bitcoin Network Security Vulnerabilities
points: Bitcoin Core developers disclosed three security flaws in the software powering most of the Bitcoin network, one rated high-severity.
The high-severity bug could have potentially stalled Bitcoin mining operations if exploited.
Bitcoin Core has released a fix addressing the immediate risk to network security.

items.title: Tokenized Assets Expansion and Market Adoption
points: OKX and ICE's tokenized stock venue (digital versions of traditional stocks on blockchain) is launching with crypto-native public companies after major tech corporations declined to participate.
Kraken's parent company Payward added 200 UK and EU stocks as xStocks, pushing the total tokenized asset count past 1,500, though UK residents cannot yet purchase the new UK-listed tokens.
The expansion shows growing infrastructure for bringing traditional financial assets onchain (as digital representations on blockchain), even as regulatory barriers persist.

items.title: Polymarket Token Launch Uncertainty
points: Polymarket's POLY token has only a 36% probability of launching by November 30, 2026, and just 48% odds of launching before 2027, per Decrypt's prediction market.
CEO Shayne Coplan stoked speculation ahead of Token2049 but revealed little concrete detail on stage, signaling hesitation around a token launch.
More crypto startups are favoring equity fundraising over issuing tokens, a trend potentially affecting Polymarket's timeline despite its reported $21 billion valuation.

items.title: Deutsche Bank Launches Bitcoin Custody
points: Deutsche Bank launches a bitcoin custody service (secure storage of crypto assets on behalf of clients) for institutional clients, marking major mainstream financial adoption in Europe.

items.title: Israel Discount Bank Offers Bitcoin Services
points: Israel Discount Bank becomes the first Israeli bank to offer bitcoin buying, holding, and selling to customers.
